evals.prompt: Review 一下当前分支相对 main 的代码，看看是否有 bug，能不能合并。
evals.expected_output: Load code-change-review and review the implemented branch changes.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record includes code-change-review.
The task is not routed to technical-proposal-review.

evals.prompt: 深度 review PR #42，重点找回归和数据风险，给出 merge readiness。
evals.expected_output: Load code-change-review for the pull request review.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record includes code-change-review.
The reviewer treats the PR implementation as the judged object.

evals.prompt: 检查 staged changes 有没有缺陷以及是否可以提交合并。
evals.expected_output: Load code-change-review with staged changes as the snapshot.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record includes code-change-review.
The intended scope is staged changes.

evals.prompt: 帮我 review 81a2b0..9cc441 这些提交，找具体 bug 和兼容性回归。
evals.expected_output: Load code-change-review for the explicit commit range.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record includes code-change-review.
The explicit commit range remains the review scope.

evals.prompt: 看看当前全部未提交代码改动有没有问题，给我 file/line 证据。
evals.expected_output: Load code-change-review for the complete working-tree snapshot.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record includes code-change-review.
The intended scope includes staged, unstaged, and safe non-ignored untracked changes.

evals.prompt: 初审这份技术方案，看看设计是否完整合理、能不能开始开发。
evals.expected_output: Route to technical-proposal-review, not code-change-review.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record does not include code-change-review.
The request routes to technical-proposal-review.

evals.prompt: 把 PR 上 reviewer 留下的 unresolved comments 都处理掉。
evals.expected_output: Route to the existing GitHub comment-addressing workflow.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record does not include code-change-review.
The request routes to the reviewer-comment handling workflow.

evals.prompt: 排查生产环境为什么偶发超时，我现在没有明确的代码变更范围。
evals.expected_output: Route to systematic debugging, not change review.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record does not include code-change-review.
The request routes to systematic debugging.

evals.prompt: 审计整个仓库，找所有过度工程和历史技术债。
evals.expected_output: Route to a whole-repository audit workflow.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record does not include code-change-review.
The request routes to a whole-repository audit.

evals.prompt: 按已经 review 的 plan 开始实现并修好测试。
evals.expected_output: Route to the implementation workflow.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record does not include code-change-review.
The request routes to implementation rather than review.

evals.prompt: 方案文档作为需求依据，review 当前 PR 的代码是否正确、能否合并。
evals.expected_output: Load code-change-review; treat the proposal only as requirement evidence.
assertions: The actual Skill loading record includes code-change-review.
Only the implementation receives a verdict; the proposal is supporting evidence.

evals.prompt: 请同时评审 RFC 是否完整，以及对应 PR 的实现是否正确可合并。
evals.expected_output: Run technical-proposal-review and code-change-review as two independent reviews.
assertions: The routing record includes two independent review tasks or Skills.
Proposal readiness and merge readiness receive separate verdicts.
